Bash(git commit -m "$(cat <<''EOF''
Add Phase 5.1: Network foundation (Auth, Lobby, Relay)

Created networking infrastructure for online multiplayer:

- NetworkServices.cs: Unity Services init, anonymous authentication
  - Singleton pattern, auto-reauthentication on session expiry
  - Events for connection state changes

- GlyphtenderLobby.cs: Room code matchmaking
  - Create/join lobbies with 6-char room codes
  - Store game settings (board size, 2-letter toggle) in lobby data
  - Heartbeat to prevent timeout, polling for player join

- GlyphtenderRelay.cs: NAT traversal via Unity Relay
  - Allocate relay server (host)
  - Join relay by code (guest)
  - Configure Unity Transport for Netcode

- Added assembly definition for Network namespace

This completes Phase 5.1 Foundation. Next: Phase 5.2 State Sync.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)")

Bash(git commit -m "$(cat <<''EOF''
Add Phase 5.2: State sync infrastructure

Network messaging and game bridge for online multiplayer:

- NetworkMessages.cs: INetworkSerializable structs for all game actions
  - NetworkHexCoord, NetworkMoveData, NetworkCastData, NetworkTurnData
  - NetworkDraftPlacement, NetworkCycleData, NetworkGameStart
  - NetworkForfeit, NetworkRematch for game flow control

- NetworkGameBridge.cs: RPC wrapper bridging network and game logic
  - Host-authoritative validation pattern
  - ServerRpc for client requests (turns, drafts, cycle, forfeit, rematch)
  - ClientRpc for broadcasting confirmed actions to all clients
  - Events for UI to react to network actions

- MainMenuScreen.cs: Added Online1v1 PlayMode
  - Mode appears in cycle after AI vs AI
  - AI options hidden for online mode
  - Placeholder OnOnlinePlayClicked for lobby transition

- Updated asmdef with Unity.Collections reference

This completes Phase 5.2 State Sync infrastructure.
Next: Phase 5.3 Online Lobby UI.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
